name: Wikipedia late navigation and stop
description: Wait for a real article section to open and inspect what happens when the browser event arrives after its deadline.
intro: Welcome. We will find an article on Wikipedia and see what happens when a browser wait expires.

steps.title: Type Ada Lovelace in Wikipedia
steps.say: I move to Wikipedia's search field and type Ada Lovelace. The matching article appears below the field.

steps.title: Click the Ada Lovelace result
steps.say: I click the result in the search suggestions and check the article heading.

steps.title: Open Biography
steps.say: I open Biography from the article's contents.

steps.title: Wait for Work to open
steps.say: Leave Biography open for five seconds. After Outcome unknown, select Work in Wikipedia's contents, then choose Stop.

steps.title: Read the Work section
steps.say: When Work opens within the deadline, I scroll down to read the section.

steps.title: Close the walkthrough window
steps.say: I close the rehearsal window after reading Work.
